 HONOR Play 20A Debuts in PH with Rear Screen from Php 8,099
 Gadgets , News , Philippines , Smartphones HONOR Play 20A Debuts in PH with Rear Screen from Php 8,099 
 HONOR Philippines has officially launched the HONOR Play 20A with an interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen, 6.9-inch 90Hz display, 6000mAh battery, and early Shopee 11.11 promo price starting at Php 8,099.
 Jam Ancheta November 7, 2026 
 2 MIN READ Share X Facebook Messenger Threads Copy link Add Jam Online as a preferred source on Google → HONOR Philippines has officially introduced the HONOR Play 20A in the country and it’s bringing a unique dual-screen smartphone experience to budget-conscious consumers.
 The device debuts exclusively on Shopee during the 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale with a special introductory price of Php 8,099, discounted from its regular suggested retail price of Php 8,999.
 2-inch Smart Rear Screen for Quick Controls
 The defining highlight of the HONOR Play 20A is its interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen positioned next to the rear camera module.
 This functional secondary display lets users glance at incoming notifications, manage music playback, and check the time without turning on the main display.
 It also doubles as a convenient mirror viewfinder, allowing mobile photographers to capture high-resolution selfies and video clips using the primary rear camera.
 The HONOR Play 20A features an interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen and a massive 6,000mAh battery. Expansive 6.9-inch 90Hz Display and 6,000mAh Battery
 Up front, the smartphone sports a 6.9-inch display equipped with a smooth 90Hz refresh rate for content consumption.
 Under the hood, a massive 6,000mAh battery keeps the hardware powered across daily schedules without frequent recharging.
 Exclusive Shopee 11.11 Deals and Flexible Payment Plans
 Early shoppers can secure the HONOR Play 20A exclusively on Shopee on November 11, discounted from its regular suggested retail price of Php 8,999 down to Php 8,099.
 Buyers can also stack a 20 percent off Mega Discount Voucher alongside free shipping promotions to maximize their seasonal savings.
 Flexible installment terms allow consumers to purchase the device for as low as Php 45 per day over six months at 0 percent interest via SPayLater and MariBank.
 Special Shopee Live sessions featuring James Afante on November 10 at 12:00 PM, and Kris Aquino with Bimby Aquino on November 10 at 6:00 PM, will unlock additional platform freebies ahead of the nationwide store release on November 28, 2026.
